# @bitcode/generic-attachments-external

**ExternalAttachment** — base Attachment for data attached via **Externals**
auxillary connections (GitHub VCS provider, Notion, Jira, Linear, Figma, …).

```
Attachment (primitive) → ExternalAttachment (this)
```

Vocabulary is **external** (not “integration”) so product language matches the
Externals surface where all external connections live.
